verdict.rationale: Expensify's own marketing says it can build workspace rules and automatically approve expenses, which touches the core of policy-driven auto-approval. The evidence never shows per-category or per-role limits, context-based rules, or routing only out-of-policy exceptions to a human approver. Smart Limits are card spend caps, an adjacent control rather than policy codification. Missing for 10: documented category/role/context limit configuration, explicit exception-only routing to human approvers, in-depth first-party policy docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can codify our expense policy — limits by category, role, and context — so in-policy expenses auto-approve and only exceptions reach a human

citations.quote: Automatically create, submit, approve, and reimburse expenses.
